svg.title: A rectangle with ragged edges, like a torn slip of paper, frames two rows of signs with nothing between them. The top row has two waved lines of different lengths, two snakes, a triangle, a short waved line, and a triangle. The second row has a waved line, a heart followed by a dot, a snake, a triangle, and a waved line. Below and to the right, in handwriting, are the date “Nov 15” and the name “Morris,” with a line under it.
